designationHistory.indexText: Pilot Knob National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1987 when the Pilot Knob Ore Company donated the 90-acre summit of Pilot Knob, whose old iron mines shelter wintering Indiana bats, under the Endangered Species Act.

authority.citation: Donation accepted under the Endangered Species Act of 1973
